body: They do the knee twice because the first set of images was not clear enough at the back.
The doctor is careful with the word wear. He uses it four times and each time he puts something in front of it.

choices.text: Ask how many years are in it.
choices.outcome_text: He says that is not a question the images answer. Then he answers it anyway, roughly, and he is not wrong.
Outside it has started to snow on snow that has already been walked on.

body: The money went into the roof of the west stand, which has been temporary for six years.
The director shows you the invoice without meaning anything by it. It is simply what is on his desk.

choices.outcome_text: He says next year is next year. He has said it before and it has been true both times.
It is for slightly less than four seasons of what they would have paid you.

body: The place has gone to a twenty-year-old they have had since he was fourteen. Nobody had to decide anything.
He warms up beside you on the Tuesday and copies the thing you do with your ankles.

choices.text: Show him how to do it properly.
choices.outcome_text: He gets it on the fourth go. He says thanks twice, once at the time and once at the end of the session.
He follows a week later and does it beside you again, and this time you leave it.

body: The release from your club had to be countersigned by a man who was on leave until the seventeenth.
The window shut on the fifteenth. He came back to a stack of them and yours was near the middle.

choices.text: Ask if anything can be appealed.
choices.outcome_text: There is a form for it. It is submitted to the same office and it is not urgent.
You are still registered here. Training is at half nine and the bus goes from the corner.

body: Nothing was against you. They looked properly and they took their time about it.
At twenty-six the question they are asking has changed shape, and you can hear the new shape in how they say it.

choices.outcome_text: They say they are looking for someone to have for five years. You understand the sentence completely.
The drive back is two hours and you do it with the radio off.
